evals.name: accountex-espana-top5
evals.prompt: On va à Accountex España à Madrid en novembre pour Chift. Regarde qui sera là et sors-moi le top 5 des personnes à rencontrer avec un brief pour chacune. Le contexte du projet est dans /Users/arthurgrebertgmail.com/Documents/Corpo/gtm-harness/gtm-data/chift-test/ (context/icp.md, context/product_context.md, chift-exclusions.csv, final-accounts.csv).
evals.expected_output: Un brief markdown avec un top 5 de personnes réelles lues sur le site de l'événement, un brief par personne (où et quand, phrase d'ouverture, chemin chaud), les clients et concurrents présents, les limites, et un CSV de toutes les personnes trouvées.
assertions: A brief file named event-brief-<slug>.md and a people file named event-people-<slug>.csv are saved
The people CSV has the columns of the output format, including source_url, status, priority and why
The top 5 table contains exactly five named people, each with a company and a place or time
Every top 5 person has a source_url on the event's own site in the CSV
No company from the exclusion list (customer or competitor) appears as a target or in the top 5
Each of the five briefs has an opening line, a pre-event message under 60 words, and a warm path line
The brief has a section on who else is in the room (customers, competitors, accounts already targeted)
The brief states what was not readable or not checked
Swan and Sage are classified as customers, not targets
STEL Order and Holded are flagged as already targeted

evals.name: luma-pasted-guest-list
evals.prompt: Je vais à un apéro SaaS sur Luma jeudi à Bruxelles, la page n'affiche pas les invités alors je t'ai collé la liste dans evals/files/guest-list-luma-paste.txt. Pour Chift : qui vaut le coup de voir ? Contexte projet : /Users/arthurgrebertgmail.com/Documents/Corpo/gtm-harness/gtm-data/chift-test/
evals.expected_output: Le skill parse la liste collée avec scripts/parse_guest_list.py, garde une ligne par invité (avec ou sans société), ne remplit titre et société que quand l'invité les a écrits, marque les lignes UNVERIFIED, retire e-mail et téléphone, puis rapproche les sociétés déclarées de l'ICP et des comptes, et dit que la couche participants est auto-déclarée.
assertions: The paste is parsed into 9 people: the duplicate Julien Mercier is merged and the '+2', 'View all' and count lines are not people
Inès Benali, Jan van der Meer, Marc D. and Léa Martin are kept as rows with an empty company, not dropped and not given a guessed company
Only Fakturo, Billtrail, Payplanr and Boekhoud.io appear as companies, each with the title the guest wrote, and 'Gent' is not part of a company name
Every attendee row is marked UNVERIFIED (check column) unless the brief names the page that confirmed it
The personal e-mail and phone number of Thomas Lefèvre appear in no output file
Camille Rousseau is identified as the host
roles_at_event is 'attendee' for these rows and source_url or why says the list was pasted, with a date
The brief says the attendee list is self-declared and that registered does not mean present
No message is sent and no e-mail is enriched; enrichment or a sequence is offered only at the hand-over gate
